text: The bladed rocket is a weapon mod for the baseball bat in the Fallout 4 add-on Nuka-World.

The Black Devil was a former officer of the Enclave that deserted in the past, stealing a set of X-02 power armor and fleeing to the Commonwealth where they became a vigilante defending the innocent until age forced them to retire and abandon the armor sometime before 2287.
The bleedout syringe barrel is a weapon mod for the syringer .
The bloatfly larva syringe barrel is a weapon mod for the syringer .
The Black Rider power armor skin is a power armor skin in Fallout 76.
Bob is a used car salesman who runs Bob's Pre-Owned Car Mart in 2161.
The blue batting helmet is a piece of headwear in Fallout 4.
The clean blue suit and dirty blue suit are pieces of clothing in Fallout 4. They take up every free armor slot except for the head.
The Bloodletter is a unique weapon in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor.
The Blue Ridge branding iron is a unique one-handed melee weapon .

The Blue Ridge scout outfit and the matching Blue Ridge scout helmet are an outfit , available from plans received from Beasts of Burden and Costa Business: Herschel. A matching hat is unused and is not obtainable.
The Blue Demon power armor paint or the Blue Demon prototype paint is a power armor skin .

The bloody spacesuit and matching bloody spacesuit helmet (also known as the bloody space helmet) are an outfit set .
The Bombshell armor is a unique piece of armor in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt.

Bog Walker is an achievement/trophy . It is granted for discovering all locations in Point Lookout. There are 31 total locations in Point Lookout, but the player is only required to find 29. The Explorer perk makes this somewhat easier to accomplish.

The Boulder Train Station is the initial entry point into Boulder for the player character and the only access point for all trains that enter and leave the city. Victor Presper has a personal train he used to get here.
The Boulder City train station is an unmarked location within Boulder City in the Mojave Wasteland .
The Boomers helmet is a piece of headwear in Fallout: New Vegas.
Doctor Borous is a pre-War scientist and member of the Think Tank residing in Big MT in 2281.
The Boogeyman's hood is a unique helmet that appears in Fallout 3.
The Boulder City train station terminal entries is a terminal entries from the Boulder City train station in Fallout: New Vegas.
The boosted capacitor is a weapon mod for the Gatling laser, the Institute laser, the laser gun and the plasma gun . It does not require any perks to craft.
The boosted gamma wave emitter is a weapon mod for the Gatling laser, the Institute laser, the laser gun and the plasma gun .
The boosted photon agitator is a weapon mod for the Gatling laser, the Institute laser, the laser gun and the plasma gun .
The boosted plasma thrower is a weapon that is added to Fallout Shelter with the update 1.4
Bolstering is a first star armor and power armor legendary mod .

* Bounty hunters, characters associated with bounty hunting and claiming bounties in the Fallout series. * Armor and clothing: ** Bounty hunter duster, an item of clothing in Fallout: New Vegas. ** Bounty hunter gear, a rare outfit in Fallout Shelter. * Holotapes and notes: ** Bounty notice: Junders Plunkett, a unique bounty and holotape available with the Lawbringer perk in Fallout 3. ** Bounty notice, a holodisk carried by Regulators if the Lone Wanderer has bad Karma in Fallout 3. ** Motor-Runner Bounty, a holotape in Fallout: New Vegas. ** Bounty: Wanted in Concord, a paper note in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Anti-Materiel Rifle." * Quests: ** Three-Card Bounty, a side quest in Fallout: New Vegas. ** Bounty Killer, an unmarked quest in Fallout: New Vegas. ** Bounty: 'Ol One-Eye, a daily quest in Fallout Shelter. ** Do Bob's bounty hunter jobs, a quest in Van Buren. * Other: ** Survivalist's Bounty, a challenge in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Honest Hearts. ** Butcher's Bounty, a perk in Fallout 76. ** Bounty Hunter, an achievement/trophy unlocked by killing a wanted player in Fallout 76.

Brahmin armor is a suit of armor with attributes identical to the leather armor Mk II. It gives its wearer the appearance of a common brahmin, unless the wearer is a ghoul, super mutant, humanoid robot, or Pipboy; for those characters, their appearance is unchanged.
Boutique Le Chic is a store run by Lydia Montenegro in Tenpenny Tower. The store sells a variety of goods, from ammunition and armor to custom themes for the Tenpenny Tower suite.
Scribe Bowditch is the proctor of the Order of the Shield and head of the Brotherhood of Steel's smithy in the Citadel .
The bridge is an open, two-tiered deck on Mothership Zeta in 2277. It serves as the ship's main control room. Several aliens reside here along with the alien captain.
The bow is a weapon that was to appear in Van Buren, the canceled Fallout 3 by Black Isle Studios.
The bracketed short barrel is a barrel weapon mod for the laser musket .
The bracketed long barrel is a barrel weapon mod for the laser musket .
Bounty: Wanted in Concord is a paper note in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Anti-Materiel Rifle."
Bounty: Wanted in Beacon Hill is a paper note in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Anti-Materiel Rifle."
Bow Before Me is a Perception-based perk in the Fallout 76 update Wastelanders.
The bowling ball launcher is a unused weapon mod for the Fat Man and its unique variants The Guarantee and Daisycutter .

Brotherhood zeppelin is a rigid-frame dirigible using gasbags filled with lighter-than-air gases that are lighter than air to achieve liftoff and can be controlled from a main cabin. A zeppelin is a type of rigid airship.
Broken Banks is an area mentioned by Tobar, owner of the ship named the Duchess Gambit. The location may be located near water, as Tobar would often sail to it while his ship was in better condition.

The Brotherhood T-51b power armor is a piece of armor in Fallout: New Vegas.
The broken power armor and broken power helmet are pieces of armor in Fallout: New Vegas.
Broken recon armor is a piece of armor in Fallout: New Vegas.
The brush gun forged receiver is a weapon mod in Fallout: New Vegas.
Brotherhood T-45d power armor is a type of armor in Fallout: New Vegas. <!--==Background==
The broken grenade launcher is a weapon in Fallout: New Vegas.
The broken missile launcher is a weapon in Fallout: New Vegas.
The broken laser rifle is a special, unobtainable version of the laser rifle in Fallout: New Vegas.
Bring a GECK to Isaac in exchange for his power armor was going to be a quest in Van Buren, the canceled Fallout 3 by Black Isle Studios.
The brown flight helmet is a piece of headwear found in Fallout 4.
The Brotherhood recon rifle is a non-automatic rifle in Fallout 76. It is technically a regular hunting rifle with a custom name and prefab modification loadout.
The bruising full stock is a weapon mod for the pipe revolver .
The Brotherhood special ops suit and Brotherhood special ops mask are an apparel set .
Brotherhood Ship Arrives is a quest in Fallout: The Board Game.
Brotherhood recon rifle schematics is a miscellaneous item .
Bust up Wright's still beneath the train station is a quest in Fallout 2.
Buster is NCR's premier weapon seller and runs Buster's Fine Emporium of Armament in 2241.
The bus is a cut vehicle from Fallout Tactics. It is a standard bus which was modified by the Brotherhood of Steel for their needs.
Build a freeze-gun was going to be a quest in Van Buren, the canceled Fallout 3 by Black Isle Studios. It was located in B.O.M.B.-001.
Buster's Fine Emporium of Armament is a small gun store run from a tent by the eponymous owner, Buster, in New California in 2241.
Butch's 10mm pistol is a unique, non-playable small gun in Fallout 3.
The bull barrel is a weapon mod for the .44 pistol . It requires at least rank 3 of the Gun Nut perk.
The business suit is a common outfit in Fallout Shelter. It was added to the game with the 1.5 update.
Butcher's Hook is a unique unarmed weapon in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor.
The butcher knife is a weapon . It was added in the 1.6 update.
Burned on the River is a side quest in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Solar Cannon."
The bug grenade is a weapon in the Fallout 76 update Wild Appalachia.
Bug spray was to be a weapon in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Honest Hearts.
Burning is a weapon mod for the sheepsquatch club and Sheepsquatch staff in the Fallout 76 update Wild Appalachia.
Burning barbed is a weapon mod for the sheepsquatch club and sheepsquatch staff in the Fallout 76 update Wild Appalachia.

Bryce Biederman is a stunt performer who plays multiple roles in the Fallout TV series. He portrays the first Vault 32 raider shot by Lucy with the tranq gun in "The End," and also plays an NCR soldier in "The Radio" and "The Beginning."
The burnt Vault 63 security outfit and burnt Vault 63 security helmet is an outfit set .
The burnt Vault 63 riot control outfit and burnt Vault 63 riot control helmet is an outfit set .
Burning is a third star armor and power armor legendary mod .
Build a Suit is a cut miscellaneous quest in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Vault Suit Customization."

CC-00 power armor is a set of power armor in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Captain Cosmos."
The CC-00 helmet prop is a cut junk item in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Captain Cosmos."
The Calico Liberty 100 is a small gun found in Fallout Tactics.
Caesar's Legion armor is armor of various types in Fallout: New Vegas.
Cal is the owner of Cal's gun shop in the PMV Valdez in 2241.
Cait is a cage fighter working at the Combat Zone in the Commonwealth in 2287. She is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.
Cage armor and helmeted cage armor are pieces of armor in Fallout 4.
The calibrated powerful receiver is a weapon mod in Fallout 4.
The calibrated pipe rifle is a weapon that is added to Fallout Shelter with the update 1.4
The camouflage pant suit and camouflage short suit are outfits .
The CR-74L drill guide is a miscellaneous item in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "CR-74L Combat Rifle."
The CR-74L is a weapon in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "CR-74L Combat Rifle."
The calibrated beta wave tuner is a weapon mod for the plasma gun .
The calibrated capacitor is a weapon mod for several energy weapons .
Cal's gun shop is a shop in the PMV Valdez owned by Cal in 2241.
Call to Axe-ion was a community event in the form of a limited-time series of challenges for Fallout 76. It ran from November 15 to November 29, 2022.

The Cambridge underground labs is a unmarked location in the Commonwealth in the Fallout 4 Creations content "The Varmint Rifle." The labs can be entered through the manhole cover in the road near a fallen billboard, directly west of Cambridge Polymer Labs / Fraternal Post 115.
Carl Wallace, driver #09899, was a truck driver for the Nuka-Cola Corporation.
The car dealership is an unmarked location in the Capital Wasteland. It can be found northeast of the Fairfax ruins and northwest of the Red Racer factory.
The Captain's Sidearm is a weapon which is added to Fallout 3 in the Mothership Zeta add-on. It is a unique, cleaner and shinier alien blaster used by the alien captain.
The car fuel cell is a miscellaneous item that was cut from the final version of Fallout 2.
The cargo plane is a vehicle that appears in the Mojave Wasteland.
The capacitor boosting coil is a weapon mod for the Gauss rifle . It requires rank 4 of the Gun Nut perk and rank 3 of the Science! perk to craft.
The car tree camp is an unmarked location in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Can You See Me Now? is a side quest in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Chinese Stealth Armor."
The Captain Cosmos space suit is a piece of clothing in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Captain Cosmos."
The Captain Cosmos power armor figurine is a miscellaneous item in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Captain Cosmos."
Candy cane is a weapon mod for the walking cane in Fallout 76.
The Captain Cosmos suit and its three colored variances, along with the Captain Cosmos helmet are outfit sets .
A carbine is a rifle that has a barrel shortened from its original length. Most carbines are generally compact versions of a longer rifle or are rifles chambered for less powerful cartridges. __TOC__
The cattle prod is a weapon which appears in Fallout, Fallout 2, Fallout: New Vegas, Fallout 76 (Nuclear Winter and Wastelanders updates), and Fallout Tactics. __TOC__

This script is an object script (SCN) that handles the critical hit effect of the Gauss rifle in the Operation: Anchorage add-on for Fallout 3. When a critical hit occurs, it pushes the target (referenced as mySelf) away from the Lone Wanderer with a force of 10 units, creating a knockback effect to enhance combat dynamics in the Anchorage Reclamation simulation.

{{Transcript|text= ScriptName DLC01:DLC01_TrackSystemTrap extends DLC01:DLC01_TrackSystemTrapBase {Part of the DLC01 Track System. Script on the Tank and Mine traps.} ; ;The Tank and Mine traps are Destructible MovableStatics while they're on the track. Their destruction state handles the player shooting them during this time. ;When the track system wants to drop them, it calls OnActivate. We then swap the MovableStatic for the corresponding Projectile object. ;It would be simpler to just use the Projectile directly, but Projectiles have different physics behavior, and jitter uncontrollably when moved on platforms like this. Projectile property myProjectile Auto Const Mandatory {The projectile we swap for this object when the object is activated.} Sound property mySound Auto Const Mandatory {Sound to play when the swap occurs.} ;When the Track System wants to drop the trap, it activates them. ;Make sure we only spawn the projectile version of the trap if the MovableStatic hasn't already been destroyed. Event OnActivate(ObjectReference akActivator) if (!Self.IsDestroyed()) ObjectReference p = Self.PlaceAtMe(myProjectile) Self.DisableNoWait() mySound.Play(p) Self.Delete() EndIf EndEvent }}

This script extends DLC01:DLC01_AddFormsEffectScript and dynamically restricts the use of unstable weapon mods on the player’s robot companion during combat in Fallout 4s Automatron DLC. It runs a repeating timer while the robot is in combat, checking the current target’s distance from the robot and player, as well as the target’s level relative to the player. If the target meets the configured safety criteria (within min/max range, player not too close, target not too weak), the script adds the mod effects via the parent class; otherwise, it removes them to prevent unsafe or ineffective use (e.g., point-blank Fat Man on a radroach). {{Transcript|text= Scriptname DLC01:DLC01_UnstableModRestrictionScript extends DLC01:DLC01_AddFormsEffectScript {Script for unstable mods on the player's robot. During combat (only), runs a timer, checks conditions, and adds or removes AddFormsEffectScript's forms based on whether those conditions are met.} ; ;Essentially, this script tries to prevent the robot from using a mod on an on unsuitable target, such as using a Fat Man against a radroach at point-blank range. It's not going ;to be perfect, but it seems to work well in practice. This script is an object script (SCN) attached to a workbench in the Enclave Car Tunnel during the Broken Steel add-on for Fallout 3. On load, it records the workbench’s starting position. In GameMode, it monitors whether the workbench has been moved more than 40 units in any direction (or if the Lone Wanderer is not wearing Enclave armor). Once either condition is met, it sets a flag and forces the linked Scribe (DLC03ZCarTunnelScribeBRef) to evaluate its package, allowing scripted behavior changes (such as reacting to the player clearing or accessing the area).
This script, used in Point Lookout in the quest The Velvet Curtain, manages player interaction with the sunken submarine’s self-destruct mechanism.
This script runs The Dismemberer weapon, with an 80% chance to dismember a dead target when gore is enabled, restoring a small amount of the player’s Action Points.

This script is a trigger script (SCN) that triggers unique companion dialogue lines in the cargo hold of the alien ship during Fallout 3s Mothership Zeta add-on. It is placed in a specific area of the cargo hold and causes each of the three active companions to deliver their version of the line DLC05ConvCargo08 exactly once when they individually enter the trigger volume.
